literal: Having known the assembly and having analyzed, let them speak, those of purity who have known the range of words.
translation: Let those of pure character, who know the power and classification of words, speak only after assessing the nature of the assembly and analyzing their audience.
modern: சொற்களின் தொகுதியை நன்கு அறிந்த தூய்மையான பண்புடையவர்கள், தாங்கள் பேசும் அவையின் தன்மையை அறிந்து, ஆராய்ந்து அதற்குப் பிறகு பேச வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the prerequisite for effective public speaking. It addresses those of 'purity' (தூய்மையவர்), meaning people of flawless character and intellect who have mastered the vast range and classification of words (சொல்லின் தொகை அறிந்த). Even such experts must not speak hastily; they are advised to first understand the nature of the gathering (அவை அறிந்து) and carefully analyze the context (ஆராய்ந்து) before delivering their speech (சொல்லுக).
